title.en: An Act to Confirm and Ratify All steps Taken for the Erection, Maintenance, and Improvement of National Monuments and Particularly for the Erection of a Monument to the Memory of Andres Bonifacio, to Authorize the Creation of a Committee or Committees for Taking Up Popular Subscriptions, and to Appropriate Funds therefor.

text.en:
The preliminary steps taken with a view to erecting a monument to the memory of Andres
Bonifacio and the idea of erecting, maintaining, and improving national monuments of this character, as
expressed in Act Numbered Twenty-four hundred and ninety-four, are hereby confirmed and ratified. For this
purpose and in order to expedite as much as possible the realization of the plan s to erect a monument to the
memory of Andres Bonifacio, the Secretary of the Interior is authorized to appoint a committee or committees
for the purpose of taking up popular subscriptions in such manner and subject to such conditions as said
Secretary of the Interior may prescribe. The members of these committees shall serve without compensation.
The funds so collected shall be expended by the Secretary of the Interior in any manner conducive to the
purpose of the subscription, that is, the erection of the monument, which may include the ordinary payment of
agents for the collection on a percentage or per diem basis, in the discretion of said Secretary of the Interior.

As soon as in the discretion of the Secretary of the Interior a sufficient sum shall have been
raised by popular subscription, the Insular Government shall contribute a like sum for the expenses above
mentioned, and said Secretary of the Interior shall forthwith direct the work of the erection of the monument
to be begun. The Secretary of the Interior may designate any officer or employee of the Insular Government,
the city of Manila, or any provincial or municipal government for duty, either individually or as member of a
committee, in connection with any work relative to the erection of said monument or the collection of funds
therefor, without additional compensation.

There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, the sum of twenty-five thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, which sum
shall be at the disposal of the Secretary of the Interior for the purposes of this Act.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, February 23, 1918.
